places.name: Rumtek Monastery
places.description: The most important Kagyu Buddhist monastery outside Tibet and one of India's most significant Tibetan heritage sites.
places.bestTime: October to May; Drupchen and Tsechu festivals

places.name: Kanchenjunga Viewpoint (Gangtok)
places.description: Dawn views of Kanchenjunga, the world's third highest peak, in its full saffron glory.

places.name: Enchey Monastery
places.description: The most atmospheric hilltop monastery within Gangtok town, with spectacular Kanchenjunga views on clear days.

places.name: MG Marg
places.description: The cleanest and most pleasant bazaar street in Himalayan India — shopping and street food without the chaos.
places.mapsSearch: MG Marg Gangtok Sikkim pedestrian street

places.name: Tsomgo Lake (Changu Lake)
places.description: A high-altitude glacial lake that freezes solid in winter, just 40 km from Gangtok on the Tibet highway.
places.mapsSearch: Tsomgo Lake Changu Lake Gangtok Sikkim
places.bestTime: October to May; June for rhododendron and primula

places.name: Nathu La Pass
places.description: Stand on the ancient Silk Road at the India-China border, at 4310 metres, open to Indian nationals with permit.
places.mapsSearch: Nathu La Pass Sikkim India China border
places.bestTime: May to November (closed by snow otherwise)

places.name: Namgyal Institute of Tibetology
places.description: One of the world's most important repositories of Tibetan Buddhist art and manuscripts, founded with the Dalai Lama's blessing.
places.mapsSearch: Namgyal Institute of Tibetology Gangtok Sikkim

places.name: Gangtok Ropeway
places.description: Float over Gangtok's terraced townscape with Kanchenjunga framed in the distance on clear days.

places.name: Do Drul Chorten Stupa
places.description: Sikkim's most important stupa and the spiritual centre of Nyingma Buddhism in the region.
places.mapsSearch: Do Drul Chorten Stupa Gangtok Sikkim

places.name: Flower Exhibition Centre (Sikkim)
places.description: The world's richest per-area orchid diversity on display — 450+ varieties in one Himalayan garden.
places.mapsSearch: Flower Exhibition Centre Sikkim Gangtok orchid
